name: Queen Mother Ramonda
oracle_text:
When Queen Mother Ramonda enters, you become the monarch.
As long as you're the monarch, creatures with power 2 or less can't attack you.
blocked_sentences: As long as you're the monarch, creatures with power 2 or less can't attack you.

needs.what: a continuous static that forbids creatures matching its `affects` filter from attacking the source's controller (the player only), while still letting them attack planeswalkers that player controls (506.2) -- e.g. an `or_planeswalkers: false` switch on `cant_attack_you`, mirroring how `attack_tax` only reaches planeswalkers with `or_planeswalkers`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `cant_attack_you` static is the right shape (affects filter {controller: any, types: [Creature], power <= 2}, condition {is_monarch: you}) but `player_statics.attack_defender_forbidden` always extends the wall to planeswalkers the controller has, by design for Combat Calligrapher's "you or planeswalkers you control"; Ramonda names only "you", so using it would wrongly forbid attacks on her controller's planeswalkers. The `cant_attack_player` op is a timed one-shot with no creature filter, and `cant_attack` names no defender at all.
